verdict_reason: The 003-A and role-filter links check out, but SCN-PLANTS-CONSIGNOR-001-B is marked full against a consignor fixture of exactly 8 addresses, so no linked test proves the eight-a-page paging the scenario now claims.

todos.issue: SCN-PLANTS-CONSIGNOR-001-B now claims 'eight a page' and listing 'across its pages', and its fit link is marked strength full, but the consignor picker is declared with wholeCount: 8 (consignor-select.fit.spec.js:109, controller.test.js:76 at plants-frontend ad743ba), so the page holds every address on one page, no pagination renders and openLastPageOfPicker (fit/high-risk-plants-journey.js:1041) clicks nothing. A page size of 9, 10 or unlimited still passes the linked test, so no link proves the eight-a-page cap or paging for this picker, which the ticket AC requires ('each is linked to a test that proves it').
todos.fix: Must: SCN-PLANTS-CONSIGNOR-001-B is linked, at strength full, to a test that turns red if the consignor picker shows more than eight addresses on a page or stops listing the role-less address on a later page; otherwise the fit link is downgraded to partial with a note saying paging is not exercised. One way: add a ninth consignor-role (or role-less) stub address so the consignor fixture holds more than eight, raise wholeCount to match, and keep the link full; or link the consignment-contact picker's paging test only if the scenario is reworded to the shared picker rule.
